Capping each initial cohort size at 2 preserves every later ≥2 threshold and the entire per-cohort orbit, yielding exactly (3³−1)²=676 universal capacity signatures independent of graph size. Every period-three configuration is all-vertex rotation; the 53 period-three capacity signatures satisfy (*) and have a≥4, and require b≥2 if a=4; constructions at (4,2) and (5,1) extend to all larger sizes. The specified t=5 witness at (3,3) exists and remains under increasing masses of capped cohorts. Multinomial species exponential GFs Φ0=1,Φ1=z,Φ2=e^z−1−z then give exact N_{t,p}; union bound over clique initial color count≤1 gives 1−3(2/3)^a−a(2/3)^(a−1), uniform in b.
